governance.constitution:
- Refine's components are model (entities), process (supervisor to manage running processes), prompts (LLM templates), surfaces (interfaces into refine), tools (reusable functions for workflow steps), and workflow (defined workflow which calls out to tools). These map directly to src/[model| process|prompts|surfaces|tools|workflow].
- Refine uses a flat file persistence, file-based indexes, in-memory caching, and Rust to maintain high performance. Ensure <50ms performance on CLI and API calls (assuming we are not waiting on LLMs or outside tools).
- Ensure that the architecture is maintained and is consistent. Do not invent new architectural concepts; instead, follow the existing architecture.
- Ensure that documentation, especially src/intent/*, is maintained and the existing document format is preserved.
- Ensure Refine remains "agent-first" by using installed coding-agent CLIs. Do not duplicate coding agent functionality.
governance.product: Refine is a local-first, agent-first operating layer for software delivery. It moves user-defined Goals through a workflow to ensure parallel implementation across Nodes, quality, and governance.

rules.text: Keep component code within `src/{model,process,prompts,surfaces,tools,workflow}` and extend existing architecture instead of inventing new concepts.
Preserve Rust-based flat-file persistence, file indexes, and in-memory caching; keep non-external CLI/API work under 50ms.
Update affected documentation—especially `src/intent/*`—without changing its established format.
Use installed coding-agent CLIs for coding-agent capabilities; do not reimplement them.

findings.description: The checklist does not require a test that keeps the bulk request pending and proves the asynchronous-work toast is emitted before the request resolves, so an implementation could preserve the reported delay while appearing covered by ordinary immediate-response tests.
findings.recommendation: Require focused tests for the Goals bulk panel and equivalent command path that assert the toast appears while the API promise is pending and that a later background-operation response does not emit a duplicate notice.

result.summary: Add a deterministic timing regression check before implementation.

checklist.description: Define one cohesive Goals bulk-submission feedback path that emits the working-asynchronously toast before awaiting the request and suppresses a duplicate notice when the response contains a background operation.

Apply the immediate feedback path consistently to the Goals bulk-actions panel and equivalent web command actions while retaining their existing success, partial-failure, error, and post-completion refresh behavior.

Add focused tests for the Goals bulk panel and equivalent command path that hold the API promise pending, assert the toast appears before settlement, and confirm a later background-operation response does not emit a duplicate notice.
Update the Goal browser intent page to state that confirmed bulk actions receive immediate asynchronous-work acknowledgement before their authoritative outcome is available.

criticism_resolutions.resolution: Added focused pending-promise timing tests for both bulk entry points, including duplicate suppression after a background-operation response.

result.summary: The Goals web surface will immediately acknowledge each confirmed bulk submission with one informational toast that Refine is working on it asynchronously, using a shared feedback path across the bulk panel and equivalent commands so users are not left waiting while final outcomes and refreshed Goal state remain authoritative.

checklist.evidence: Added submitGoalsBulkAction in goals-bulk.js. It emits exactly one 'Refine is working on it asynchronously.' info toast before awaiting POST /api/goals/bulk, then resolves a returned background operation without passing a second notice message.

Routed openBulkModal, runBulkStatusCommand, and runFailedBackCommand through submitGoalsBulkAction while retaining existing result toasts, partial-failure warning, error handling, and Goals/Dashboard refreshes.

Added tests/web_goals_bulk_async_feedback.test.js with pending API promises for both panel and command paths; each asserts acknowledgement before settlement and exactly one acknowledgement after a later operation response. Updated the existing partial-failure expectation to include the new immediate notice.
Updated docs/intent/04-surfaces/03-browser/08-goal.md to require immediate asynchronous-work acknowledgement before the authoritative bulk outcome.
